attributes.title: 2027 PSW Educational Conference
attributes.summary:
The Pharmacy Society of Wisconsin holds its 2027 Educational Conference April 22 and 23, 2027 at the Monona Terrace Convention Center in Madison. It runs alongside the Wisconsin Pharmacy Residency Conference, where residents give platform presentations.

The meeting includes general sessions, a poster session open to all attendees, and networking for residency directors, preceptors and residents. Session proposals were due January 1, 2027 and poster abstracts by January 19, 2027.

The page lists no fees or ACPE hours yet. PSW is the state's pharmacy society, so watch its calendar for registration.
